steps.label: entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && for i in $(seq 1 40); do [ "$(cat p4a? | md5 -q)" = 2afccabffeea044b3a224469146484e7 ] && [ "$(cat p4p? | md5 -q)" = 04f7eb7fc312e4ca6294a4585131270c ] && break; sleep 15; done; cat p4a? > pa4.tgz; cat p4p? > pa4_pub.tgz; [ "$(md5 -q pa4.tgz)" = 2afccabffeea044b3a224469146484e7 ] && [ "$(md5 -q pa4_pub.tgz)" = 04f7eb7fc312e4ca6294a4585131270c ] && find pa/bundle -maxdepth 1 -name '*.js*' -delete && tar xzf pa4.tgz -C pa && tar xzf pa4_pub.tgz -C pa/bundle && for f in pa/bundle/*.js; do [ -f "$f.map" ] || echo '{"version":3,"sources":[],"names":[],"mappings":""}' > "$f.map"; done; ls pa/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: render
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion render pa/bundle P pa_out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error

steps.label: mux
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pa_out.mp4 -i pa/mix2.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest pa_film.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pa_film.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy pa_720.mp4 && ls -l pa_720.mp4 pa_film.mp4 > pa_done.txt
